dct_description_sm:
Delineates the 2031 Regional Urban Boundary, as displayed on Brampton Plan Schedule 1A.  In order to provide certainty as to which lands are being proposed for urban purposes and which lands will remain agricultural or rural within the timeframe of the Region of Peel Official Plan, a Regional Urban Boundary was established, within which urban growth will be planned to occur in a phased manner until 2031.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
